versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-oss-browser-upload-cors-diagnosis v0.0.1

- Initial release for Alibaba Cloud OSS browser/miniprogram upload & CORS diagnosis.
- Provides read-only, script-driven analysis of CORS/preflight, rule presence/effectiveness, expose-headers (ETag/x-oss-request-id), and PostObject issues.
- Never makes or suggests configuration changes; outputs only templates and manuals.
- Strict API usage, credential handling, and error reporting rules enforced.
- Clearly bounded scope; defers all non-direct-upload troubleshooting to sibling skills.
